title: Factory-origin source-range objects still do not prove independence from the condition-aware caller
falsifier: The G8 source-range types now have stronger identity and runtime-witness checks, but the authority object remains publicly constructible from caller-supplied identity values. A condition-aware observation caller can instantiate IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder in the 7076 causal-admission path or IndependentReentryEventSourceAuthority in the newer 8a9840b source-range path, emit a structurally contiguous range that omits a true matching reentry, and obtain factory-sealed objects because observe/record_event and seal/seal_range apply the private module seals on behalf of the caller-owned instance. Factory origin and post-seal integrity therefore do not establish that the range was captured upstream of, or independently from, the condition-aware caller. FACTORY_ORIGIN != INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_PROVENANCE.
source_audit_evidence: 7076: IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.__init__ is public and requires only supplied identity/timing/provenance values; observe/seal mint _SOURCE_EVENT_FACTORY/_SOURCE_RANGE_FACTORY seals.

7076: validate_independent_event_source_range checks recorder-origin seal plus payload digest integrity, and admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range can return causal_negative_credit=1 for a structurally matching range with no expected reentry.

7076 test: _independent_range directly instantiates IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder and test_independent_range_can_admit_genuine_complete_negative_absence receives causal_negative_credit=1 from that locally constructed range.
8a9840b: IndependentReentrySourceIdentity is directly constructible and all authority identity fields, including authority_id and authority_build_sha256, are data supplied at construction time.

8a9840b: IndependentReentryEventSourceAuthority.__init__ is public; record_event applies _EVENT_FACTORY and seal_range applies _RANGE_FACTORY to objects created by whichever code owns the authority instance.

8a9840b: an event with runtime_witness=None is valid. This is necessary for non-reentry events, but it also means an all-negative synthetic range can be constructed without any external runtime witness proving source attachment.

8a9840b: validate_independent_reentry_source_range verifies factory seals, digest integrity, event ordering/gap accounting and embedded witness validity when witnesses exist; it does not verify an external source capability or composition-root wiring receipt.

Both modules correctly state that repository construction does not mint target/runtime/semantic credit and that real target wiring remains an external obligation. The falsifier preserves that distinction and prevents repository factory seals from being promoted into proof of runtime independence.

executable_counterexample_shape.setup: Use one valid G8 observation identity and assume a matching reentry exists in the true runtime event source during the bounded window.
executable_counterexample_shape.intervention: Condition-aware code omits that true event, constructs the public source authority/recorder itself with matching identity fields, records only non-reentry events over a contiguous range, seals it, and presents the resulting range as the negative authority.
executable_counterexample_shape.current_structural_result: All module-local seal/digest/order checks can succeed because the public authority methods themselves mint the required seals. No independent source attachment is established merely by those checks.
executable_counterexample_shape.required_behavior: The result must remain UNKNOWN/zero target causal-negative credit until an exact runtime receipt proves that the range authority was bound to the real upstream event source independently of the condition-aware observation caller.

counterhypothesis: If the threat model explicitly defines possession of IndependentReentryEventSourceAuthority as a trusted capability granted only by the runtime composition root, the public Python constructor is acceptable as repository scaffolding. That interpretation still requires target evidence proving who instantiated/bound the authority and which upstream source it consumed; names, authority_id strings and module-local seals alone cannot be that proof.
required_closure: Keep repository mechanism acceptance separate from target causal-negative acceptance.

Before target negative promotion, bind the source-range authority to an exact upstream runtime source instance through independently verifiable composition/wiring evidence or a source-owned capability/receipt that the condition-aware caller cannot self-certify.

Add a caller-self-mints-authority hard-negative. Repository construction may demonstrate the structural risk; target acceptance must show that the production path cannot satisfy the independence gate using a caller-owned authority instance.

If this boundary cannot enforce topology in-process, make the target receipt carry explicit source attachment identity and independent readback, and leave causal-negative target credit at zero without it.
next_exact_action: Active G8 mutation owner should absorb this as the target-independence gate before any negative causal runtime promotion: integrate the newer source-range authority with causal admission, add the caller-self-mints-authority hard-negative, then require an exact target/VPS receipt proving upstream independent source attachment before causal-negative target credit can become nonzero.
